Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hm....
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well now that I think of it writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas
